description:
TPC benchmark metrics (Power@Size, Throughput@Size, QphH@Size/QphDS@Size) are currently
calculated correctly in power/throughput test runners and displayed in CLI output, but
they are NOT propagated to BenchmarkResults or included in JSON result files.

These metrics are a KEY DIFFERENTIATOR for BenchBox - they are the official TPC
benchmark performance metrics that users need for comparison and reporting.

Implementation uses `qph_at_size` as a single internal field, with the H/DS suffix
only added for presentation/output based on benchmark type.
